acceptance: Throughput, peak memory and failure behavior measured for native in-process, Node WASM, browser WASM, Node/Go spawn-per-call and Node/Go persistent workers at 1k to 200k nodes; decision recorded in ADR-026.

negative.fixture: truncated pack, 70 MiB oversize, SIGKILLed persistent worker

security_and_source_permissions: Only user-authorized origins are observed; form values and secret-shaped text never leave the page; no source application server is contacted; bridge and extension commands are origin- and sender-checked.
performance_memory_storage: spawn adds about 2.8 ms (Go) to 5.5 ms (Node) per call; persistent worker adds about 0.2 ms; worker RSS 2.9 to 22.9 MB
known_limitations: In-process WASM inside Go and cgo were not measured
